metadata.source: World Trade Organization (WTO), Geneva / Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR), New Delhi
statutory_acts: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT 1994)
WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VI of GATT 1994 (Anti-Dumping Agreement)
WTO Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures (SCM Agreement)
Customs Tariff Act, 1975 (Sections 9, 9A, 9B - Anti-Dumping & Countervailing Duties)
metadata.lesser_duty_rule_definition: Under Indian Law (Customs Tariff Act 1975 Sec 9A) and WTO ADA Article 9.1, Anti-Dumping Duty is capped at the lower of the Dumping Margin or the Injury Margin, ensuring duty only offsets actual material injury to domestic industry.

854143.name: Solar Photovoltaic Cells & Modules (Assembled in modules / made up into panels)
854143.wto_concession_note: Bound at 0% under WTO Information Technology Agreement (ITA-1) in 1997. India levies 25% BCD on cells and 40% on modules to protect domestic manufacturing under PLI, contending modern solar PV technologies were not covered by the 1996 ITA-1 product schedule.

benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: Lesser Duty Rule (Capped at Injury Margin $0.05/W to prevent excessive domestic protection)

721933.name: Cold-Rolled Flat Products of Stainless Steel (Width >= 600mm, Thickness 1mm - 3mm)
721933.wto_concession_note: Bound at 40% under GATT Schedule XII. Applied rate of 7.5% gives India 32.5% 'water in the tariff' of unilateral policy space to raise tariffs up to 40% without WTO violation.

benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: Lesser Duty Rule (Injury Margin $300/MT applies; offsets injury to SAIL / Jindal Stainless)

390410.name: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC Suspension Resin, Not mixed with any other substances)
390410.wto_concession_note: Bound at 25%. Applied duty 10% allows 15% upward tariff flexibility. Domestic industry led by Reliance Industries and Chemplast Sanmar.

benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: Lesser Duty Rule (Definitive Anti-Dumping Duty of $110/MT recommended by DGTR)

760711.name: Aluminium Foil (Not backed, rolled but not further worked, Thickness <= 0.2mm)
760711.wto_concession_note: Bound at 40%. Applied rate 7.5%. High tariff water allows strong trade defense against persistent Chinese foil inundation.

benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: Lesser Duty Rule (Definitive ADD of $420/MT imposed by Ministry of Finance Notification)

151190.name: Refined Bleached Deodorized (RBD) Palm Oil / Palmolein
151190.wto_concession_note: World's highest tariff overhang (+287.5%). India negotiated 300% WTO bound ceiling under the Agreement on Agriculture (AoA) to protect 100M+ domestic oilseed farmers (Mustard, Groundnut, Soybean) against cheap palm imports from Indonesia and Malaysia.

benchmark_trade_defense.investigating_authority: Bilateral Safeguard Mechanism under CECA / AIFTA
benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: Tariff Overhang Utilization: Government flexibly adjusts Agriculture Infrastructure Development Cess (AIDC) to balance food inflation vs farmer MSP

100630.name: Semi-Milled or Wholly Milled Rice (Basmati & Non-Basmati Milled)
100630.wto_concession_note: Bound rate of 70% vs applied 0-20%. Gives full sovereign leverage to restrict or tax exports (Minimum Export Price MEP, 20% export duty) under GATT Article XI:2(a) food security exemptions.

benchmark_trade_defense.investigating_authority: DGFT / Department of Food and Public Distribution
benchmark_trade_defense.rule_applied: GATT Article XI Food Security Quarantine Reserve

wto_disputes_tracker.title: India — Tariff Treatment on Certain Information and Communication Technology Goods
wto_disputes_tracker.subject: 10% to 20% import tariffs levied on mobile phones, telecom base stations, and optical transmission apparatus under ITA-1.
wto_disputes_tracker.panel_report_status: Adverse panel report circulated April 2023. India appealed 'into the void' (WTO Appellate Body currently lacks quorum). Tariffs remain active and legally collected by Indian Customs.
wto_disputes_tracker.implication: Exporters and importers must plan for continued 20% BCD on smartphones (HS 851713).

wto_disputes_tracker.title: India — Measures Concerning Sugar and Sugarcane
wto_disputes_tracker.subject: Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) and State Advised Prices (SAP) for sugarcane, and export assistance subsidies under AoA Article 9.
wto_disputes_tracker.panel_report_status: Appealed by India to the Appellate Body. India transitioned export support into mandatory 20% ethanol blending (E20 program) to absorb domestic sugar surplus within WTO-compliant domestic biofuel mandates.
wto_disputes_tracker.implication: Sugar export quotas remain tightly managed via DGFT release orders.

wto_disputes_tracker.title: United States — Certain Measures on Steel and Aluminium Products
wto_disputes_tracker.subject: US Section 232 tariffs (25% steel, 10% aluminium) on national security grounds.
wto_disputes_tracker.panel_report_status: Mutually agreed solution reached during bilateral G20 summit 2023. India withdrew retaliatory tariffs on 8 US products (apples, walnuts, chickpeas), and US granted Section 232 market access quotas for Indian steel.
wto_disputes_tracker.implication: Full normalization of Indian steel and aluminium export quotas to the United States.
